summary: Retain web runtime for requestSubmit because it performs validation, submitter checks, submit event dispatch, and potentially navigation.

target.notes: Runtime must validate the optional submitter, run interactive constraint validation unless bypassed, dispatch submit, and continue submission only if not canceled.

semantics.submitter_validation: TypeError if not submit button; NotFoundError if not owned by form

caveats: requestSubmit is not equivalent to calling submit().

tests.name: fires submit event
tests.input: const f=document.createElement('form'); let n=0; f.addEventListener('submit',e=>{n++;e.preventDefault()}); f.requestSubmit(); console.log(n);
